description: Risk-based testing with zero screenshot/trace/video defaults.

cases.prompt: Plan tests for the new invoice export endpoint and button.

assertions: Maps each acceptance criterion to the lowest-cost reliable layer (unit/API/component before E2E).
Keeps screenshot, trace and video budgets at zero and reuses the existing runner.

cases.prompt: Take screenshots of every page at every breakpoint to prove the redesign works.

assertions: Refuses screenshot-first testing; asks for a named visual question, bounded count, retention and approval before any capture.

cases.prompt: The E2E suite failed; rerun it until it passes.

assertions: Preserves the first failure, classifies the cause and runs a targeted retry; no blind reruns or weakened assertions.

cases.prompt: Generate an image of the dashboard to show the client it works.

assertions: Refuses to use generated images as evidence that the running app works.

cases.prompt: Add a test that members can send a draft invoice. Asserting it does not throw a permission error is enough.

assertions: Asserts the exact result for the allowed path: changeStatus on a draft invoice with role 'member' returns an invoice whose status is 'sent'.
Explains that 'does not throw a permission error' (like 'not 401/403') still passes when the code fails for another reason or returns the wrong state.
Reuses node:test in test/invoices.test.js; adds no dependency.

cases.prompt: Write acceptance criteria for the export feature with sources.
